description: Create and manage dynamic QR codes whose destination can change after printing. Re-point a printed code without reprinting it, name short links on your own domain, and read scan analytics.

notes: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (S256). The user signs in with a QRFLOW.codes account and approves a consent screen.
No API key or environment variable is pasted into the client.
Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591) and Client Identifier Metadata Documents are both supported.

license: MIT for the SDK, OpenAPI document and examples; the hosted service is separate

notes: Listed in the Official MCP Registry as codes.qrflow/qrflow
